Take an adoptable dog out for a few hours to dog-friendly places; sign up online (15-20 minutes, includes a short orientation video), staff match you with a dog and provide leash and water bowl, then return the dog and share notes. No adoption or foster commitment required. Short fosters of a night or a weekend are also offered through the foster program.
